description: A ground-level photograph depicts a natural landscape featuring extensive bare, brown-grey rock formations and rock debris. Prominent rock outcrops and smaller loose rocks dominate the scene, with sparse, low-lying, scrubby vegetation (likely shrubs or bushes) scattered among the rocks and on the light-coloured soil or scree at the base. The sky above is clear and light blue. This image represents the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) land cover category "Bare rocks, outcrops, cliffs and scree," which is defined as bedrock outcrops with less than 10% high vegetation. The photograph was taken in Sweden and is credited to K. Larsson.
